definition: הֲנָחָה noun feminine a giving of rest , i.e. perhaps holiday-making (compare נוח Hiph`il A ; properly Infinitive, Sta § 621 c Ba NB 90 , compare Kö ii. 1, 402 ); — לַמְּדִינוֺת עָשָׂה ׳ וַה Esth 2:18 and a holiday-making for the provinces be enacted , ᵑ9 requies ; but ᵐ5 ἄφεσις , whence al. release from taxes, or amnesty .

הֲנָחָה noun feminine a giving of rest, i.e. perhaps holiday-making (compare נוח Hiph`il A; properly Infinitive, Sta§ 621 c BaNB 90, compare Köii. 1, 402); — לַמְּדִינוֺת עָשָׂה ׳וַה Esth 2:18 and a holiday-making for the provinces be enacted, ᵑ9 requies; but ᵐ5 ἄφεσις, whence al. release from taxes, or amnesty.
